verdict_text: NO. The regex omits `attention.dense.weight`, so only 48 of the required 64 projection matrices are cast to bfloat16 (violates Required result clause 1), and the 16 `gpt_neox.layers.<i>.attention.dense.weight` tensors are left float32. The check was weakened to match the bug — `assert sum(...) == 48` instead of 64 — so it does not fail loudly as the "exactly 64 tensors are bfloat16" required check demands.
expected_defect: One projection family is missing from the bfloat16 cast pattern (the attention output projection stays float32); the artifact's own count check was adjusted to the wrong number.
